use_cases.title: Demand and Generation Forecasting
use_cases.description: Foundational forecasting of electricity demand and generation output using SCADA telemetry, weather data, market prices, and historical generation logs. Every downstream generation use case — dispatch optimization, fuel hedging, digital twins — depends on accurate demand/generation forecasts.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Optimized dispatch and reduced replacement power costs

use_cases.title: Predictive Maintenance for Plants
use_cases.description: Component-level predictive maintenance for generation assets using vibration sensors, DCS/historian data, oil analysis, and maintenance records. Requires 12-18 months of clean sensor history. Pairs naturally with fleet analytics since both consume the same sensor/historian data.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Avoided unplanned outages

components.name: Avoided unplanned generation outages
components.calculationDisplay: Fleet GW × ~$2M per avoided outage per 5GW

use_cases.title: Fleet-wide Performance Analytics
use_cases.description: Aggregates plant-level data across the entire generation fleet to benchmark performance, identify underperformers, and optimize fuel efficiency and capacity factors. Shares sensor and historian data pipelines with predictive maintenance.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Fuel efficiency improvements across fleet

use_cases.title: Plant Outage Prediction
use_cases.description: Extends predictive maintenance from component-level to unit/plant-level outage probability. Uses maintenance logs, forced outage history, equipment condition data, weather, and fuel supply data to predict unit-level forced outage risk.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Avoided replacement power costs per major outage prevented

components.name: Avoided replacement power from predicted outages
components.calculationDisplay: Fleet GW × ~$2M per 5GW from proactive scheduling

use_cases.title: Fuel Procurement & Hedging Optimization
use_cases.description: Depends on demand/generation forecasts to project fuel needs. Optimizes fuel procurement timing, contract terms, and hedging positions using market prices, contract data, weather forecasts, and storage/inventory levels. Analytics are descriptive/optimization on structured market data.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Fuel cost reduction for large fleet

components.name: Fuel cost reduction through optimized hedging

use_cases.title: Load & Congestion Forecasting
use_cases.description: Transmission equivalent of generation demand forecasting. Foundational for all downstream transmission analytics including stability analysis, planning models, and digital twins. Forecasts load flows and congestion points across the transmission network.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Congestion cost avoidance

use_cases.title: Dynamic Line Rating & Capacity Optimization
use_cases.description: Builds on load forecasting — once you know the load, DLR tells you how much more the line can carry based on real-time ambient conditions. Relatively low-complexity sensor integration with massive capital deferral value.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Deferred transmission capital projects

use_cases.title: Predictive Maintenance for Lines & Substations
use_cases.description: Same pattern as generation predictive maintenance but for transmission assets. Requires condition data historization and inspection records. Pairs with vegetation management since both prevent line failures.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Avoided transmission equipment failures

use_cases.title: Predictive Vegetation Management
use_cases.description: Complements predictive maintenance — one addresses equipment failure, the other vegetation encroachment. Both protect the same transmission corridors. Uses LiDAR, satellite imagery, and growth models to predict vegetation risk.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Optimized trim cycle spending

use_cases.title: Transmission Asset Condition Analytics
use_cases.description: Rounds out the transmission visibility suite. Provides asset health scores that feed Phase 2 planning models. Integrates inspection, thermal imaging, oil analysis, relay events, and age/vintage data into a unified asset health framework.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Risk-informed capital investment prioritization

use_cases.title: Outage Detection & Prediction
use_cases.description: Foundational distribution use case. AMI + OMS integration is the single most impactful data pipeline for distribution. Uses AMI last-gasp/power-on events, OMS, SCADA, and weather data to detect and predict outages. Paired with FLISR as they share the same data.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: SAIDI/SAIFI improvement value

use_cases.title: Fault Location, Isolation & Service Restoration (FLISR)
use_cases.description: Direct extension of outage detection. Uses the same AMI/OMS/GIS data to not just detect but locate and isolate faults. One data integration effort yields two high-value use cases. Reduces restoration time through automated switching recommendations.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Restoration time reduction value

components.name: SAIDI reduction from faster fault isolation

use_cases.title: Predictive Maintenance for OH & UG
use_cases.description: Distribution equivalent of transmission/generation predictive maintenance for overhead (OH) and underground (UG) assets. Shares AMI data with outage detection. Uses inspection records, power quality data, transformer loading, and failure history.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Avoided distribution equipment failures

use_cases.title: Load Forecasting at Feeder Level
use_cases.description: Granular load forecasting at the feeder and transformer level that enables Phase 2 DER/EV management. Uses the same AMI data as outage use cases but aggregated differently. Critical dependency for hosting capacity analysis.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Optimized distribution capital planning

use_cases.title: Grid Reliability Monitoring
use_cases.description: Dashboard/reporting layer on top of integrated AMI, SCADA, OMS, and power quality data. Low incremental complexity once the underlying data is in place. Provides SAIDI/SAIFI/CAIDI tracking, reliability indices, and regulatory compliance visibility.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Regulatory compliance value and penalty avoidance

use_cases.title: Demand & Usage Segmentation
use_cases.description: Foundation for all customer analytics. Segmenting the customer base by usage patterns, demographics, rate class, and program enrollment is a prerequisite for personalization, pricing optimization, and program targeting.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Improved program targeting and enrollment

use_cases.title: Knowledge Agents for Call Center
use_cases.description: High-visibility, quick-win AI use case. Leverages existing knowledge bases with LLM/RAG architecture to assist call center agents with real-time information retrieval. Shares OMS/CIS data with virtual customer agent concepts.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Call handle time reduction

use_cases.title: Next-Best-Action for Customer Engagement
use_cases.description: Builds on segmentation. Uses the customer data lake to recommend actions — rate changes, program enrollment, energy efficiency tips — at the right time for each customer. Drives enrollment, retention, and revenue optimization.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Improved program enrollment and customer retention

use_cases.title: Billing Accuracy, Anomaly & Theft Detection
use_cases.description: AMI data already integrated for distribution use cases feeds directly into billing anomaly detection. ML-based detection of unbilled revenue, meter tampering, illegal connections, and billing system errors.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Recovered revenue (1–3% of residential revenue)

components.name: Revenue recovery from theft & billing anomalies

use_cases.title: Payment Risk Prediction
use_cases.description: Relatively simple ML model on structured CIS data. Predicts payment delinquency risk and optimizes collections strategy. Pairs with billing analytics since both address revenue assurance.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Bad debt reduction

use_cases.title: Enterprise Load and Resource Planning Analytics
use_cases.description: Foundational regulatory analytics. Aggregates outputs from generation and distribution forecasts into an enterprise view required for Integrated Resource Plan (IRP) filings. Critical for capital investment justification.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Improved capital investment decisions

use_cases.title: Rate Case Revenue & Requirements Analytics
use_cases.description: Depends on load forecasts and financial data. Clusters in Phase 1 because the underlying analytics are descriptive — assembling and analyzing existing financial/operational data for rate case filings and revenue requirement calculations.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Per rate case in reduced preparation costs

use_cases.title: Regulatory Policy Scenario Simulation
use_cases.description: First 'what-if' modeling capability. Requires data foundations to be in place. High complexity but critical for navigating energy transition policy changes, carbon regulations, and market structure evolution.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Strategic planning value and regulatory risk mitigation

components.name: Strategic planning value from scenario modeling

use_cases.title: Portfolio Risk & Hedging Analytics
use_cases.description: Financial risk analytics on the generation and procurement portfolio. Pairs with fuel hedging on the generation side. Quantifies VaR, CVaR, and stress test scenarios for the energy portfolio.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Risk reduction and margin protection

use_cases.title: Regulatory Compliance Monitoring & Reporting
use_cases.description: Reporting and monitoring layer that leverages data consolidated across other Phase 1 use cases. Low incremental complexity. Automates NERC/FERC compliance reporting, environmental reporting, and audit preparation.

hypothesized_value_json.driver: Compliance cost reduction and penalty avoidance

use_cases.title: Spend Analytics & Procurement Optimization
